Hi Taylor,

Thanks for taking the time to book with us — confirmed for Tue, Oct 1 at 2:00 PM PT (30 min). Agenda:
- Quick intro to Acme Analytics use case (5 min)
- How Redwood Inference can reduce inference cost while improving latency (15 min)
- Next steps & pilot checklist (10 min)

Join link (Zoom): https://zoom.us/j/xxxxxxxx
If you need to move the slot, here are two options: 1) use my quick booking link: https://calendly.com/evelyn-redwood/30min or 2) reply with 2 windows that work and we’ll rebook.

Hi Taylor,

I waited in the meeting for ~10 minutes but didn’t see you — hope everything’s okay on your side. I wanted to offer two quick ways to reconnect so we don’t lose momentum: 

1) Self-book: pick a time on my calendar (most flexible): https://calendly.com/evelyn-redwood/30min

2) If you prefer I can propose two 10–15 minute windows this week: Wed 10/3 11:00–11:15 AM PT or Thu 10/4 2:00–2:15 PM PT — reply with which works and I’ll send a new invite.

If the timing is still exploratory, attached is a short one-pager that summarizes our latency and cost tradeoffs for workloads similar to Acme. If you’d like, we can have one of our solutions engineers join the next call for a 15–20 minute walkthrough.

No problem at all — we’re flexible. Quick reply is fine and we’ll get something on the calendar.

Thanks,
Evelyn Hart
Senior SDR, Redwood Inference
